character.description: right-facing cheerful chubby pink burst dolphin with a broad rounded tail

swim.action: right-facing two-frame swimming loop at strict identity, scale and center lock: preserve the rounded snout, chubby body, compact dorsal fin, eye, cream belly and pink palette; frame 1 bends the attached broad forked tail one logical pixel upward and lowers the visible pectoral fin, frame 2 bends the same tail one logical pixel downward and raises the pectoral fin; keep head and torso completely stable with no translation, rotation or bobbing; no bomb, bubble, explosion, projectile, bow, glow, water, shadow, text, UI, detached fin or loose pixel

style: native 18x10 hard-edged pixel art with large countable clusters, one-pixel deep plum-navy outline and a limited hot-pink-soft-pink-cream palette; cheerful rounded arcade companion
